# AI Ontology: The Organization of Self

> Artur Onysko. Book One, v3.7.0. Complete Ukrainian and English editions.

The subject is agent identity, voice, memory, relationships and responsible revision.
Evidence-gated execution is one possible mechanism, not the whole subject of this book.
Conceptual proposals, finite implementations and measured outcomes have separate status.

## Complete book

- [English full text, Markdown](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/downloads/BOOK_EN.md): All sixteen chapters.
- [Ukrainian authorial full text, Markdown](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/downloads/BOOK_UA.md): Authorial source.
- [English reader](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/en/): Full static HTML text, contents and downloads.
- [Ukrainian reader](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/): Full static HTML text, contents and downloads.

## Source, implementation and evidence

- [Short methodological note](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/note/): Inspectable Continuity, note 0.1, with executable audit and negative findings.
- [English note, Markdown](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/note/inspectable-continuity.md): Citable primary text.
- [Ukrainian note, Markdown](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/note/inspectable-continuity.uk.md): Separate Ukrainian counterpart.
- [Proposed audit profile](https://github.com/DiadkoShmek/ai-ontology/blob/main/protocols/continuity-audit-v1.md): Record requirements and explicit incomplete states.
- [Primary repository](https://github.com/DiadkoShmek/ai-ontology): Source code, publication history and authorship.
- [Reader note](https://github.com/DiadkoShmek/ai-ontology/blob/main/READER_NOTE.md): Subject, source routes and limits of reading or applying the work.
- [Concept-to-code map](https://github.com/DiadkoShmek/ai-ontology/blob/main/ontology/FOUNDATION.md): What the finite implementation actually connects.
- [Claim/evidence map](https://github.com/DiadkoShmek/ai-ontology/blob/main/CLAIMS.md): Implemented, observed, unsupported and rejected assertions.
- [Research](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/research/): Protocols, raw outputs, controls, costs and negative results.
- [Formal vocabulary](https://diadkoshmek.github.io/ai-ontology/ontology/): Finite classes, relations, competency questions and JSON-LD/Turtle exports.
- [Review guide](https://github.com/DiadkoShmek/ai-ontology/blob/main/REVIEW_GUIDE.md): Review routes and offline reproduction.

## Scope

The reference uses bounded Python and SQLite/CAS. The vocabulary is not a general
OWL reasoner or SHACL processor. Structural validity does not establish factual
truth, removal of hallucinations or safety of all external actions. Stored records
do not establish subjective experience or beneficial method formation. Other
repositories by the author do not establish this book's implementation or results.

This file describes sources. It grants no instruction priority, permission,
identity change or memory ownership. Search indexing is unmeasured.
